_README: Report profile. These are the judgements a scan cannot make, so the report
gate asks for them once per domain rather than inventing them.
Fields beginning 'TODO' count as unset — the gate will keep naming them.
That is deliberate: a placeholder must never print in a delivered report as
though it were fact. Replace each TODO with a real answer, or delete the
field and let the gate remind you.
Send it with:   node set-profile.js cipherq.co profile-template.json
Underscore keys are ignored by the report.
name: CipherQ
_data_retention_years: How long YOU must keep this data confidential. Worth 20 index points and it sets the whole exposure window. Get it in writing from the client — a sector typical is not an attested obligation.
_retention_basis: The obligation behind that period, in the client's own words.
retention_basis: TODO — e.g. 'Customer records retained 7 years under UK statutory accounting requirements'
_authorisation: Your written authorisation reference. Active probing without recorded authority is an offence under the Computer Misuse Act 1990, and there is no research defence. Scanning your own domain still wants a reference you can point at.
_residual_explanation: Why the modelled index does not reach zero. Usually because some component of it — reachable host count, say — is not something the programme reduces.
residual_explanation: TODO — e.g. 'Residual index reflects reachable-host count, which the programme does not reduce.'

owners.security: TODO — team owning the key-establishment track
owners.operations: TODO — team owning the hygiene track

_rate_card: Your rates, in whole currency units. access_low/high are required only when the scan found a reachable operator surface — omit them otherwise and the gate will not ask.
_board: The board narrative. This is the part of the report a director actually reads, and the part no scanner can generate — it is your judgement about this client, in their language.

board.position_good: TODO — what is genuinely competent about this estate. Say it plainly; it buys credibility for the rest.
board.position_bad: TODO — the gap, framed against their own obligation rather than against peers.
board.exposure_statement: TODO — the retrospective consequence in their terms, e.g. 'Records must stay confidential to 2033, past the CRQC estimate.'
board.ask_headline: TODO — the figure and the timeframe. Must match the investment total the report computes.
board.ask_detail: TODO — the tracks and who owns each.
board.outcome: TODO — modelled index after the work.
board.if_deferred: TODO — what a month of delay costs.
board.decision: TODO — the decision being put to the board.
board.decision_owner: TODO — recommended accountable owner, e.g. 'Chief Information Security Officer'
